verified: Crew's packaged register_app registers no agent and links no skill for an untrusted app.

For the trusted app it registers exactly the manifest's four agent files and links exactly the manifest's four skill directories, namespaced under the app name and also flat; the undeclared Medium profile and bounded-review skill that ship in the tree are left alone.

A registered profile keeps its authored tools, allowedTools, excludedTools, includeMcpJson, includePowers, resources, permissions and prompt unchanged; the steering resource stays the relative file://.kiro/steering/**/*.md and no autoApprove is written.

Crew's packaged launch projection (native_skill_view) of each registered profile lists exactly that room's @haunted-house:room-<role>/<tool> selectors, mounts no kirocrew-core server, keeps the steering resource, and is not a skill-search agent.
The same projection of a profile without excludedTools [@kirocrew-core] adds the tool @kirocrew-core/skill_search and the kirocrew-core server (inherited skill trees).
The same projection drops a skill:// resource and substitutes that skill_search tool; a profile that both maps a skill:// resource and excludes @kirocrew-core gets no launch view.
Crew expands a relative skill:// URI in the session project and a skill://~/ URI in the home folder; there is no form relative to the installed app.
Crew's session-label builder re-declares only the profile's own room server per session.

guidance.medium: The Medium profile and bounded-review skill ship in the tree but stay out of the manifest while the Séance Room is disabled, so Crew registers neither.
guidance.owner_visibility: A declared skill also appears in the owner's own Crew skill catalog under its plain name; that is Crew's flat link and gives no Ghost any tool.
guidance.profiles: resources is exactly [file://.kiro/steering/**/*.md]; excludedTools is exactly [@kirocrew-core]; includeMcpJson and includePowers are false; no skill:// entry, because Crew replaces it with a tool outside the room catalog and refuses the view when that tool is excluded.
guidance.skills: Declare each enabled role's skill directory in the manifest so it is installed and reviewable. The backend reads <app root>/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md (adapters/room_skills.read_room_skill_block) and puts the delimited block at the front of the assignment prompt; nothing is inherited from the owner's or the Mansion's skill folders.
